findings.message: This is a visual concept of a robot arm rebuilt from the image. Parts are shapes, not sourced products; wiring, power, fit and function were not checked
Sizes are estimated from the image (about 406 x 430 x 252 mm overall)
2 internal parts are typical for a robot arm, inferred rather than seen in the image; their type, size and placement are guesses

concept.summary: A black desktop robot arm: star base plate, round pedestal with an aluminium turntable ring, twin-plate upper arm, tube forearm, servo wrist with chrome bolts and a geared two-finger gripper, with a controller board by the base.
